_comment: Route policy read by the kit's hooks/route.ps1 on every prompt and hooks/subagent.ps1 at every subagent start (DES-13). Tunables only. groups: law group id -> words that activate it (whole-word, case-insensitive, matched against the prompt); the group ids must exist as '## GROUP - Title' sections in LAW.md, so an overlay group an adopter adds gets a line here. folders: top-level folder under root -> groups active whenever the session works there. alwaysForSubagents: groups every subagent receives even when nothing routed yet. maxChars: cap per injection, under the host's 10,000-character limit. A route sticks for the session; entry.ps1 clears it on compaction.
_stateCard: GAME-13, read by hooks/entry.ps1 at session start. A session that starts inside a repository whose top-level folder is mapped (in folders) to one of stateCard.groups gets a state card built from that repository's DECISIONS.md, HANDOFF.md and git. Map your games folder to GAME in folders to switch it on, for example "games": ["GAME", "DES"]. staleCommits: a hand-off further behind HEAD than this is flagged. lineChars, maxChars: size caps. closedWords (optional): the status words that mean a timeline row is closed. groups empty: no card. anyRepoWithHandoff (DES-14, default false): true also gives a card to any repository under root that holds HANDOFF.md or docs\HANDOFF.md, whatever its folder; the card then prints the hand-off's '## Next session' section as the next prompt.
